instruction: A candid action photograph captures a dance rehearsal in an indoor studio with a dark background and wooden floor. In the center, the bearded man in the rust-brown shirt (R1) stands facing left, lifting the woman with pulled-back hair in the yellow shirt (R2) horizontally. The woman (R2) arches her back mid-air, looking downwards. On the far left, the clean-shaven man in the rust-brown shirt (R3) stands facing right, supporting the legs of an upside-down dancer. On the right, a bystander couple in matching dance attire performs a similar lift. The scene is illuminated by soft overhead lighting, highlighting the warm earth tones of the dancers' clothing against the dark backdrop.
elements: R1 stands and lifts R2 horizontally in the dance rehearsal

R2 is airborne with an arched back while being lifted by R1
